verdict.rationale: ADP documents API Central, a paid add-on that gives developers self-service API discovery, use-case templates, documentation, code samples, and OAuth 2.0/OpenID Connect auth, so a programmatic path exists. However, none of the API Central evidence names RUN, so it is unproven how much of RUN (running payroll, managing employees) can be driven through it. It is also a separately purchased product rather than an included public API. missing for 10: explicit evidence that API Central covers RUN operations, a list of the RUN API endpoints and capabilities, inspectable public API reference docs (developers.adp.com serves only a client-rendered shell to keyless fetches), and independent hands-on corroboration of driving RUN via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Developers have self-service access to API use case templates, associated documentation and code collection samples, plus responsive virtual support when needed.
API Central can be purchased online and digitally activated within minutes. Immediately after activation, developers can create integration projects and security certificates
API Central leverages OpenID Connect and OAuth 2.0 authentication and authorization to ensure only authorized users and systems can access the data
developers to automate HR processes through integration for accurate, real-time data sharing, eliminating file-based imports and exports.
